rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for backing a person or cause, and for evidence supporting a claim.

example.english: I support you in taking part in this election.
example.traditional: 我支持你參加今次選舉。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zi1 ci4 nei5 caam1 gaa1 gam1 ci3 syun2 geoi2

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for assistance, including financial help and a product’s supported features.

example.english: Thanks for always giving me support.
example.jyutping: do1 ze6 nei5 jat1 zik6 bei2 ngo5 zi1 wun4

rows.note: Use this when the support consists of evidence for a claim or theory.

example.english: This report provides support for the claim.
example.traditional: 呢份報告係支持呢個講法嘅證據。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 hai6 zi1 ci4 ni1 go3 gong2 faat3 ge3 zing3 geoi3

rows.note: Use this for a physical supporting post or pillar, rather than for help or evidence.

example.english: This pillar provides support for the whole building.
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 cyu5 zi1 caang1 zyu6 seng4 dung6 lau4

rows.note: Use this for physically holding something up or keeping it from collapsing.

example.english: This pillar can support the whole bridge.
example.traditional: 呢條柱可以支撐成座橋。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 cyu5 ho2 ji5 zi1 caang1 seng4 zo6 kiu4

rows.note: Use this when the support specifically involves giving money or funding a project or organization.

example.english: This company will support us financially in running this project.
example.traditional: 呢間公司資助我哋搞呢個計劃。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zi1 zo6 ngo5 dei6 gaau2 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this when support means sustaining life, a livelihood, or an ongoing condition rather than favoring it.

example.english: This part-time job is enough to support my living.
example.traditional: 呢份兼職夠我維持生活。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gim1 zik1 gau3 ngo5 wai4 ci4 sang1 wut6
